The Indian Women’s Hockey Team delivered a dominant performance in their second Pool D clash of the FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026, defeating South Africa 6–1 to register their biggest-ever win at the FIH Hockey World Cup.
India produced an attacking masterclass to take control of the contest and secure a commanding victory, moving to the top of Pool D in the process.
Watch the highlights from India’s record-breaking second Pool D clash against South Africa!
